newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Fujimori to visit Japan in July.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Fujimori to visit Japan in July.

text.p: Peru's President Alberto Fujimori will visit Japan in the first week of July, accepting an invitation made by Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto during a trip to Lima last month, Government Palace said on Wednesday.

The official trip -- July 2 to July 7 -- will be the fifth meeting in the last year between the two leaders, who were confronted by a four-month hostage crisis at the Japanese ambassador's home in Lima.
Hashimoto visited Lima last month to formally thank Fujimori for the April 22 rescue of hostages being held by rebels from the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement.

Palace officials said the Peruvian president would also meet with former ambassador to Peru Morihisa Aoki, who resigned from his post due to harsh criticism in Japan for his role in allowing the security lapse at his home.

Despite the diplomat's fall from grace in his homeland, the Peruvian government decorated Aoki with the country's highest honour -- the Order of the Sun -- in recognition of his dignified resolve during the crisis.
